definitions.explanation: To put food onto a plate or into a bowl for serving.
To stack or pile things up.
To secretly put poison into food or drink.

examples.japanese: ⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{茶碗|ちゃわん}→茶碗：01019_chawan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{盛|も}る。
examples.english: I serve rice into a bowl.

examples.japanese: ⟦サラダ→サラダ：01364_sarada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{皿|さら}→皿：00883_sara⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦きれいに→きれい：00717_kirei⟧{盛|も}り{付|つ}けた。
examples.english: I arranged the salad nicely on a plate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{土|つち}→土：02229_tsuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{盛|も}って⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: We piled up soil to make a mound.

examples.japanese: ⟦{皿|さら}→皿：00883_sara⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{山盛|やまも}りに→山盛り：noentry⟧{盛|も}った。
examples.english: I heaped vegetables high on the plate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{飲|の}み{物|もの}→飲み物：02929_nomimono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{毒|どく}→毒：10052_doku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{盛|も}った。
examples.english: The criminal put poison in the drink.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{王様|おうさま}→王様：01902_ousama⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{毒|どく}→毒：10052_doku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{盛|も}る⟦{暗殺|あんさつ}→暗殺：noentry⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: In the old days, there were often assassinations by poisoning the king.

notes:
{盛|も}る means to heap up or serve food into a container.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Takes を particle: ご{飯|はん}を{盛|も}る

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ご{飯|はん}を{盛|も}る: to serve rice
- {盛|も}り{付|つ}け: presentation, arrangement (of food)
- {大盛|おおも}り: large serving
- {山盛|やまも}り: heaping portion
- てんこ{盛|も}り: piled high

CAUTION:
{毒|どく}を{盛|も}る means 'to poison (someone)' - putting poison in food/drink.
